failure.title: Queue Lighthouse loaded-state proof aborted without retaining its raw failed report
failure.note: The completed fresh smoke retained the structured queue loaded-state abort, redacted pre-cleanup container log, safe teardown, and exact empty post-teardown inventories. The harness failed before persisting the raw failed Lighthouse report, and that evidence gap is explicitly disclosed rather than reconstructed.
failure.diagnosis: The custom gatherer sampled the measured navigation once without waiting for its asynchronous loaded marker, and loaded-state extraction threw before the failed Lighthouse payload was durably written. The historical raw audit artifact remains unavailable and is disclosed; source analysis identified the unbounded single-sample lifecycle defect.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
